[b]The Dowager Queen[/b]

"Have you not seen the papers these days?" Inquired an old wavering voice to a young maid who was cleaning the shades of a dusty old wood panelled room with a duster.

"I have ma'am, it's all imperial these days ma'am," replied the maid, turning to look at the voice, a thin and aged female Thrømm, bedecked in pearls and finery that would outrival a renaissance monarch.

"How odd it is, one day that I would see my descendants crowned Empresses and Emperors, and what of I? Tossed into the corner as if I am not the senior of this household! Hah!"

The maid gave no comment, calmly moving to the next window, and opening the blinds to clean them, casting a beam of light upon the pale and half-blind face of the queen.

"It is a travesty, but I shall see it righted, I shall see it righted, come Giselle, help me forth!" declared the queen, motioning for the maid to help her up onto her feet, which she did so carefully.
